title: Retire two BIT helpers and bind the compact caller at c > 0.00174485376
body:
The current BIT word retains a helper with no VALUE/COPY uses, and the earlier compact GL464 change can remove a second helper. This contribution integrates both changes with a **fresh signed dirty inverse/D0, SOURCE cleanup, compact 658-stream interface and complete parent owner/caller binding**. The final package is `research/bit-compact-carrier-retirement`.

The full construction has **900,416 paid QUERYs** (public PR4183: 902,592), unchanged rank mass **1,808,352**, original stock **28,416**, and nine additional private families with no DATA credit. All removed helper supports return as actual paid idle.

The conservative moment root is strictly bracketed by

```
1744853764761145849274 / 10^24
1744853764761145849275 / 10^24
```

Its lower endpoint is **0.41562% above** PR4183 head `59a1d97a86ea82b4d62958d705709ea46d7509f1`'s upper endpoint, and **0.10294% above** this PR's earlier packing-only upper endpoint. A sufficient actual logical separator is **b = 174481/100000000 = 0.00174481**, with

```
T(n,w) <= 200 C n + 10000000 C n^(1-b) w.
```

The precision prefactor increases. These exponent/majorant comparisons do not assert a lower runtime at every finite width.

This is a **conditional source-bound logical p=1 BIT supplier** for fixed q>2^80 on the retained canonical/root-coupled domain and compatible fresh-row stock. Fixed physical tapes, complete physical arena cleanup, arbitrary-stock outer padding and the multiplication join remain open. The selected whole κ and complex supplier are unchanged. No maintainer approval or independent human certification is claimed.

The new actual word uses 658 ordinary streams,436 helpers and private index658. All658 independent RAW columns, both orientations, signed SOURCE/helper restoration, both inverse compositions and nine immutable COPY/ERASE leases are checked. The old local endpoint on the deleted helper is intentionally removed; the actual full parent DATA endpoint is completed by the new idle ledger. No old all-role endpoint or dirty correction is silently reused.

The assignment covers **125,568 helper occurrences and288 calls**. Exact terminal operators, physical supports, chronology and complete idle returns are checked. The current Catalogue/Topology/Consumer has 28,138 canonical requests,540 split bases,2701 charts and81 COPY guards. Actual new rank7 threshold traces and recursive Frame/private CLEAR probes are bound to the compact word. Proper-rank native guards are unchanged.

The fresh cancellation-free bounds F=70697651 and R=546751590 require charged finite caps **192/320/640**, with historical selector bound1149 and route bound159. These are charged explicitly and separated from the unchanged runtime atom/register constructors; the logical p=1 proof absorbs changed finite constants in C/F'_q.

Validation: Python3.12 registered normal/`-O` replays, independent code-disjoint SOURCE/operator and exact rational-price audits, a separate complete owner/chronology/idle audit, live native/owner/source/caller defects, raw committed-byte/source-history preflight, and a fresh Git-free committed export. `VALIDATION.json` records actual commands, environments, commits and outcomes. The verifier uses only the standard library. Hosted CI is separate evidence: [run39582008408](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39582008408) passed at the exact current head `080f8c218d64c6d231ed6297987e39b7a912a4ef`, including the registered replays of both packages.

[External finite audit #4335](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4335), head `49e899e9601afa5aa5223e39dceac1c9099db3a5`, independently checks the transcribed profile's moment bracket, gain and majorant constants with a separate rational interval engine. Its checked precision gap is about `1.4209e-7`, exceeding the required `1e-7`. We replayed that exact audit normally and with `-O` on Python3.12.14 from a Git-free export. Its scope excludes rebuilding the profile from the WORD, SOURCE/caller correctness and physical admission; its hosted run currently requires maintainer action. This is separate from approval or a new whole-kappa claim.

[External literal-profile audit #4349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4349), head `3dfce32a21f28a5a837df3d4158187df9ce6cc75`, separately rebuilds all2,899 MOVE charges, nine COPY charges, both21,988-record frame traces and all288 calls/125,568 helper occurrences. Its derived profile agrees with900,416 queries, rank mass1,808,352 and DATA stock28,416, excluding the nine private families. The separate Fraction oracle checks all636 frame ranks and2,384 MOVE containments. Its [exact-head hosted replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39595701195) passed. We also replayed its unmodified31-file Git-free package normally and with `-O` on Python3.12.14, with all17 retained source inputs byte-identical to this head. This closes the finite histogram-binding gap left by #4335; it does not certify numeric COPY/ERASE equality, SOURCE/native operators, physical realization or the outer join.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-compact-carrier-retirement
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-compact-carrier-retirement --check-source-history
```

The earlier `bit-stage-mixedwidth-packing` package remains byte-for-byte available for its first validated result. New canonical manifests bind the actual compact word; `provider/historical/` retains the original public WORD and old receipts as citation-only material. The registered direct verifier needs no Git/network. `RECORD.json` separates the moment bracket, actual separator, comparison and publication status. `TASK.json` records the original selected-packing card and human-assigned BIT scope change.

Credit: Ross Richardson's PR4183 delayed retirement/logical admission and PR4021 terminal retirement; our earlier PR3647 GL464 node; Ali Romman, Sagar Thakrar, cheesegrader, commdata2338, CubeJerry, Jose Manuel, David Arias and all retained source-specific predecessor notices. PR4021 had already removed the final rank4 promotion, which is not counted again. Prepared for ai-nanachi with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including internal code-disjoint AI reviews. New work Apache-2.0; original notices retained.
